text: "then yes make large databases always on right? cause we can never lose money" — approving: dply databases of 1, 2 and 4 CU are always on (no sleep), and each large size is priced so a lone tenant covers the whole node it brings up at ≥1.3× cost (1 CU gets a higher per-CU price; 2 and 4 CU keep $0.12/CU-h, which already clears it).
